prompt_fragments.hard_rule:
PLUSH HARD RULE (non-negotiable):
Reconstruct as a soft stuffed designer-toy object with filled puffy volume.
Absorb doodle stroke/outline colors into the fabric surface — do NOT keep a thick crayon, marker, or decal ring outline wrapped around the object.
Short controlled soft-pile / felted texture ONLY — suggestion of fabric, not photographic fur.
TRUE transparent cutout (alpha). NEVER white/gray rectangular backdrop, ground plane, cast-shadow scene, or studio paper.
